item.title: Evolution of GPI and Cartridge Web: Key Milestones
item.description:
Company Journey: Major Milestones from 1978 to Present
#

1978 - 1989
#

  • 1978
    General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI) was founded by Chairman Mr. Jack Wang.
  • 1986
    The company expanded into plastic molding production, specializing in toner cartridges for copiers and printers.

1990 - 1999
#

  • 1995
    GPI established a second plant and increased its production capacity to seven lines.
  • 1996
    Initiated ISO 9002 implementation to enhance quality management.
  • 1997
    Achieved ISO 9002 certification.
  • 1998
    Continued efforts to improve quality through ISO 9002.
  • 1999
    Developed and successfully introduced OPC drum bases to the market, establishing capabilities for manufacturing complex OPC bases. Upgraded gears to JIS4 standards. In October, GPI developed precision gears with a 60mm outside diameter for copiers and began mass production.

2000 - 2009
#

  • 2000
    The company name was officially changed to General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. in April. In May, GPI issued stocks, and by August, total capital increased to 9.7 million USD.
  • 2001
    Shares were listed on the OTC market (Code: 6128).
  • 2002
    In April, GPI began mass production of its first model of complex “All in one” laser printer toner cartridges and developed several additional models.
  • 2003
    Shares transitioned to listing on the TWSE.
  • 2006
    Total capital increased to 22.6 million USD.
  • 2008
    The Cartridge Web brand was created for the finished goods wholesale market, focusing on toner cartridges for printers.
  • 2009
    The Cartridge Web brand was further developed, seeking regional distributors and wholesalers. Total capital increased to 47.5 million USD.

2010 - Present
#

  • 2010
    Construction began on a hotel building in the Taichung Harbor region.
  • 2012
    Achieved ISO 14001 certification.
  • 2013
    Grand opening of the Taichung Harbor Hotel in March.
  • 2018
    Completed the 100% acquisition of Katun Holdings LP, the world’s largest distributor of aftermarket imaging supplies. Capital was further increased by cash.
  • 2021
    Achieved ISO 13485 certification.

For more information, visit GPI’s official website or contact us .
